text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ma~me-chin♪
Ma~me, ma~me, ma~me, ma~me~chin♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Bea~ns, bea~ns, bea~ns, bea~ns, bea~ns, bea~ns, bea~ns.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: D-Don't taunt the loser!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's running away agai—
Golshiiii-saaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Don't go causing trouble for Fenomeno at the Arima either! Golshiii!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm tellin' ya!
Mame-chin is just chasing after me on her own!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Do not make statements contrary to the facts!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*...
Where is she... Where's Golshi-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Over here, over here~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what... That's dangerous, sir!
Rolling around on the turf like that...
If I had taken even one more step forwardâ

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: No way I'd step on it. It's Mame-chin, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Don't go getting weirdly confident.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah ha ha ha!
Let it slide, it's not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right, Mame-chin?
Beyond Japan, beyond the whole world.
Let's do the most fun thing in the entire universe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Not older, not younger—
our generation is definitely gonna be the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ......You again...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...I will only say what I am about to say once.
So keep your ears open."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yeah. What's up?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for everything.
